title.suggested: Allen Defeats McCoole and Celebrates at His Saloon

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Allen beat Mike McCoole to a pulp on September 23, 1873, taking only a skinned knuckle, then started a $100 subscription for his victim and was mobbed by admirers at his saloon that night.

metadata.notes: Page header reads 'The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, Wednesday, September 24, 1873.'

facts.fact: Allen defeated Mike McCoole on September 23, 1873, without a single knock-down; McCoole's face was battered while Allen only had the skin knocked off one knuckle
Allen called the McCoole fight a slaughter and said he was sorry for his opponent
facts.quote: a bloody useless slaughter after the fourth round. ... I was sorry for him. I was just ashamed to hit him any more. Poor fellow!

facts.fact: On the boat home Allen started a subscription for McCoole with $100; McCoole declined it and it was divided between trainers Madden and 'Tricks'
After the fight Allen appeared at his saloon at 8:30 p.m. before a packed crowd and gave a one-line speech
facts.quote: Well, gentlemen, now you have all seen me and know how I look, I guess you'd all better take a walk.
